why: Bodies whose suggestions internal/model and web/src/suggestion.ts must read the same way. Go reads this file from internal/model/model_test.go, the browser side from web/test/suggestion.test.ts, so a fix applied to one implementation and not the other fails here rather than in a review.

cases.name: no suggestion
cases.why: prose alone proposes nothing

cases.name: one block
cases.why: the ordinary case

cases.name: two blocks
cases.why: a comment may propose more than one change

cases.name: tilde fence
cases.why: ~~~ opens a block too, and holds backticks without escaping

cases.name: longer fence around a code block
cases.why: the writer lengthened the fence to hold the nested one

cases.name: suggestion proposing a code block
cases.why: the nested fence is replacement text, not the end of the block

cases.name: suggestion proposing a tilde block
cases.why: nesting is tracked by fence character, not only by backticks

cases.name: nested fence indented inside a list item
cases.why: a fence keeps its meaning when the line is indented

cases.name: a run longer than the nested fence closes the suggestion
cases.why: a close never needs to be longer than what it closes, so the longer run is the suggestion's

cases.name: an unclosed nested fence still ends at the suggestion fence
cases.why: the suggestion's own fence wins when the nested block is never closed

cases.name: plain code block is not a suggestion
cases.why: only the suggestion info string proposes a change

cases.name: quoted suggestion is not a suggestion
cases.why: a comment teaching the format shows a block, it does not propose one
cases.body:
Here is how you write one:

`````markdown
```suggestion
not a real one
```
`````

cases.name: quoted inside a tilde block
cases.why: the quoting block need not use the same fence character

cases.name: a quoting fence no longer than the one it holds
cases.why: the first bare fence closes the quoting block, so nothing is proposed

cases.name: a real suggestion after a quoted one still counts
cases.why: skipping the quoted block must not swallow the rest of the body

cases.name: a quoted suggestion beside a real one holding a code block
cases.why: only tracking nested fences and skipping quoted blocks together give one whole suggestion

cases.name: a suggestion quoted inside a diff block
cases.why: an agent quoting a diff opens a block that runs to its own close, so what it holds is shown rather than proposed

cases.name: empty suggestion deletes the lines
cases.why: an empty block is a proposal to remove the commented lines

cases.name: a fence written mid-line opens nothing
cases.why: a fence has to start the line, or prose with code spans would open blocks

cases.name: the info string is matched without case
cases.why: SUGGESTION is the same word
